title: The Typewriter of Manchester's mill district
author: Sebastian Hartwell
blurb: Silas Ravensworth, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
